# Native44 deterministic evaluator candidate

Status: source-fit and expected-record review required before packaging. This
fixture declares an ordinary supplied F_D GraphFunction. It is not generic GLC
policy, a semantic assessment or a historical runtime record.

The source is the complete 6120-byte original selection, SHA-256
`c799b9e43d660f3abc3adf0da32baab17a771f1efe20843c4688162b9e62ced4`,
preserved by native44's job. Binding10 requires an admitted deterministic
derivation of execution status, plan agreement, pass counts and stdout digest.
Binding11 requires distinct computed records for component pass, UAT pass,
planSatisfied and the expected pass floor. Their exact policy/shape and all
fifteen original binding identities are selected from the retained owner value.

The input is the generic `lifecycle_evaluation_input` after existing ABI native
reacquisition. The evaluator uses the original admitted execution observation,
the acquired exact current context, the retained plan and verifier digests, and
the explicit reviewed test-role selectors. It reads supplied values only.

`commandAgreement` means plan command `node` resolves to the selected original
executable `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/24.7.0/bin/node`; argv equality is exact and
cwd is `.`. This mapping is an explicit fixture interpretation, not a PATH
lookup or claim that a different executable is equivalent. The fixture selects
the single `planned-verifier-run` command from the admitted nine-command result.

The pass/fail/cancelled counters each require one complete numeric summary line
in that command's digest-verified stdout. The current Node reporter and TAP
`#` summary forms are supported. Each role's exact reviewed title must occur in
its pinned verifier and one passing observation line in the combined command.
No separate command is substituted for that combined command. A supported
prefix-glyph change alone does not reject it; pass-floor success, zero failures,
zero cancellations and successful non-timed-out execution remain required.
Unknown reporter formats refuse rather than infer positive results.

`planSatisfied` is the conjunction of exact command/argv/cwd agreement,
successful execution, the plan's nonempty stdout fragment, the declared pass
floor, zero failures and zero cancellations. The four binding11 records are
componentPassed, uatPassed, planSatisfied and passFloor. A false condition is
retained as computed evidence, not converted into semantic satisfaction.

The expected current records are frozen in `expected-native44.json`. Source
execution/result/observation and producer identities are retained in the actual
output; ABG provides the new evaluator invocation/result provenance. The output
labels its role `computed_derivation` and original-task completion `not_claimed`.
It neither overwrites old observations nor invents missing raw argument/type
fields. Binding12 historical input provenance, binding14, remaining semantic
assessment and owner/S06 acceptance are outside this selected increment.

The fixture's exact raw source, full retained execution, currentness and source
fit remain separate proof duties. Pure expected-record tests do not establish
ABG admission or physical currentness. Installed qualification must enter the
generated ordinary Program and authenticate/reobserve with the real owners.
